name: Ride to Ironforge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge.  From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe.  You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild.  That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!

Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
narrative.objectives: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
narrative.requestItemsText: What can I do for you, sir?
